headline: Strong data center traction; gradual margin recovery

highlights: Within domestic business, power generation revenue declined 2% YoY, impacted by project execution and data center product mix, although data centers continued to contribute 30-40% of power generation sales.
Non-data center power generation demand remained healthy, with growth across realty, manufacturing and residential segments.

Distribution business grew ~13% YoY to INR9bn, while industrial revenue increased ~5% to INR4.1bn, with rail, marine and compressor businesses witnessing temporary execution and supply-chain-related challenges.

Management highlighted robust demand and a healthy inquiry pipeline in data centers, supported by the ongoing AI- led infrastructure investment cycle, while acknowledging capacity and supplier constraints in ramping up QSK60 production.
